kernel_evaluate =: 4 : 0
    'positions values bandwidth kernel local_linear' =. 5{.x
    used =. I.(|positions-y)<bandwidth
    weights =. (#positions)$0.0
    minimum =. 1+local_linear
    if. (#used)<minimum do.
        (<0),(<0.0),<weights return.
    end.
    x0 =. y%100
    h =. bandwidth%100
    kappa =. ('epanechnikov';'biweight';'triweight')i.<kernel
    kappa =. kappa{0.75 0.9375 1.09375
    kernels =. i.0
    differences =. i.0
    for_index. used do.
        delta =. ((index{positions)%100)-x0
        u =. delta%h
        t =. 1-u*u
        weight =. kappa*t
        if. -.kernel-:'epanechnikov' do.
            weight =. weight*t
        end.
        if. kernel-:'triweight' do.
            weight =. weight*t
        end.
        kernels =. kernels,weight
        differences =. differences,delta
    end.
    s0 =. 0.0
    s1 =. 0.0
    s2 =. 0.0
    t0 =. 0.0
    t1 =. 0.0
    for_offset. i.#used do.
        index =. offset{used
        k =. offset{kernels
        d =. offset{differences
        s0 =. s0+k
        s1 =. s1+k*d
        s2 =. s2+(k*d)*d
        t0 =. t0+k*index{values
        t1 =. t1+(k*d)*index{values
    end.
    if. local_linear do.
        determinant =. (s0*s2)-s1*s1
        estimate =. ((s2*t0)-s1*t1)%determinant
        for_offset. i.#used do.
            index =. offset{used
            weight =. ((offset{kernels)*(s2-s1*offset{differences))%determinant
            weights =. weight index}weights
        end.
    else.
        estimate =. t0%s0
        weights =. (kernels%s0)used}weights
    end.
    (<1),(<estimate),<weights
)
kernel_fit =: 3 : 0
    'positions values bandwidth kernel local_linear diagnostics' =. y
    model =. (<positions),(<values),(<bandwidth),(<kernel),<local_linear
    fitted =. i.0
    leverage =. i.0
    defined =. 1
    if. diagnostics do.
        for_index. i.#positions do.
            'valid estimate weights' =. model kernel_evaluate index{positions
            fitted =. fitted,estimate
            if. valid do.
                leverage =. leverage,index{weights
            else.
                defined =. 0
            end.
        end.
    end.
    model,(<fitted),(<leverage),(<defined),<ordered_sum leverage
)

cholesky =: 3 : 0
    size =. #y
    lower =. (size,size)$0.0
    for_row. i.size do.
        for_column. i.row+1 do.
            sigma =. (<row,column){y
            for_k. i.column do.
                sigma =. sigma-((<row,k){lower)*(<column,k){lower
            end.
            if. row=column do.
                value =. %:sigma
            else.
                value =. sigma%(<column,column){lower
            end.
            lower =. value (<row,column)}lower
        end.
    end.
    lower
)
cholesky_solve =: 4 : 0
    size =. #y
    intermediate =. size$0.0
    solution =. size$0.0
    for_row. i.size do.
        value =. row{y
        for_k. i.row do.
            value =. value-((<row,k){x)*k{intermediate
        end.
        intermediate =. (value%(<row,row){x)row}intermediate
    end.
    for_row. |.i.size do.
        value =. row{intermediate
        for_k. (row+1)+i.(size-(row+1)) do.
            value =. value-((<k,row){x)*k{solution
        end.
        solution =. (value%(<row,row){x)row}solution
    end.
    solution
)
loess_local =: 4 : 0
    'positions values span degree rho' =. 5{.x
    count =. #positions
    q =. <.(span*count)%100
    order =. /:|positions-y
    selected =. /:~q{.order
    distance =. >./|(selected{positions)-y
    size =. degree+1
    matrix =. (size,size)$0.0
    right =. size$0.0
    rows =. 0$a:
    local_weights =. i.0
    for_index. selected do.
        a =. (|(index{positions)-y)%distance
        s =. 1-(a*a)*a
        weight =. ((s*s)*s)*index{rho
        delta =. ((index{positions)%100)-y%100
        basis =. 1.0,delta
        if. degree=2 do.
            basis =. basis,delta*delta
        end.
        rows =. rows,<basis
        local_weights =. local_weights,weight
        for_row. i.size do.
            value =. (row{right)+((weight*row{basis)*index{values)
            right =. value row}right
            for_column. i.size do.
                value =. ((<row,column){matrix)+((weight*row{basis)*column{basis)
                matrix =. value (<row,column)}matrix
            end.
        end.
    end.
    lower =. cholesky matrix
    beta =. lower cholesky_solve right
    unit =. 1 (0)}size$0.0
    zeta =. lower cholesky_solve unit
    weights =. count$0.0
    for_offset. i.q do.
        sum =. ordered_sum zeta*offset{::rows
        weights =. ((offset{local_weights)*sum)(offset{selected)}weights
    end.
    (<0{beta),(<0{zeta),<weights
)
loess_fit =: 3 : 0
    'positions values span degree iterations diagnostics' =. y
    rho =. (#positions)$1.0
    model =. (<positions),(<values),(<span),(<degree),<rho
    fitted =. i.0
    leverage =. i.0
    records =. 0 4$0.0
    if. diagnostics do.
        fits =. 0$a:
        for_position. positions do.
            fits =. fits,<model loess_local position
        end.
        for_iteration. 1+i.iterations do.
            estimates =. 0&{::&>fits
            residuals =. values-estimates
            scale =. median |residuals
            for_index. i.#rho do.
                u =. (index{residuals)%6*scale
                v =. 1-u*u
                weight =. 0.0
                if. (|u)<1 do.
                    weight =. v*v
                end.
                rho =. weight index}rho
            end.
            model =. (<rho)4}model
            updated =. 0$a:
            for_position. positions do.
                updated =. updated,<model loess_local position
            end.
            change =. >./|(0&{::&>updated)-estimates
            records =. records,iteration,scale,(+/0=rho),change
            fits =. updated
        end.
        fitted =. 0&{::&>fits
        leverage =. rho*1&{::&>fits
    end.
    model,(<fitted),(<leverage),(<ordered_sum leverage),<records
)

pava =: 4 : 0
    blocks =. 0 4$0
    for_index. i.#y do.
        blocks =. blocks,index,index,(index{y),1
        while. 1<#blocks do.
            a =. _2{blocks
            b =. {:blocks
            left =. (2{a)*3{b
            right =. (2{b)*3{a
            violates =. left>right
            if. x-:'decreasing' do.
                violates =. left<right
            end.
            if. -.violates do.
                break.
            end.
            merged =. (0{a),(1{b),((2{a)+2{b),((3{a)+3{b)
            blocks =. (_2}.blocks),merged
        end.
    end.
    fitted =. (#y)$0.0
    for_block. blocks do.
        'first last sum count' =. block
        selected =. first+i.1+last-first
        fitted =. (sum%100*count)selected}fitted
    end.
    (<fitted),<blocks
)
fit_model =: 3 : 0
    'method parameter points mode robust diagnostics' =. y
    positions =. 0{"1 points
    numbers =. 1{"1 points
    values =. numbers%100
    count =. #points
    fitted =. i.0
    leverage =. i.0
    has_edf =. 1
    edf =. 0.0
    extras =. i.0
    if. method-:'linear' do.
        x =. positions%100
        xbar =. (ordered_sum x)%count
        ybar =. (ordered_sum values)%count
        sxx =. 0.0
        sxy =. 0.0
        for_index. i.count do.
            dx =. (index{x)-xbar
            sxx =. sxx+dx*dx
            sxy =. sxy+dx*((index{values)-ybar)
        end.
        slope =. sxy%sxx
        intercept =. ybar-slope*xbar
        fitted =. intercept+slope*x
        leverage =. (1%count)+(*:x-xbar)%sxx
        edf =. 2.0
        extras =. xbar,sxx,slope,intercept
    elseif. ('running_mean'-:method)+.'running_median'-:method do.
        half =. <.((num parameter)-1)%2
        windows =. 0 2$0
        for_index. i.count do.
            radius =. half<.index<.(count-1)-index
            selected =. (index-radius)+i.1+2*radius
            sample =. selected{numbers
            windows =. windows,(index-radius),index+radius
            value =. (+/sample)%100*#sample
            if. method-:'running_median' do.
                value =. (radius{/:~sample)%100
            end.
            fitted =. fitted,value
            leverage =. leverage,1%#sample
        end.
        has_edf =. method-:'running_mean'
        edf =. ordered_sum leverage
        extras =. windows
    elseif. method-:'isotonic' do.
        direction =. mode
        rss_increasing =. 0.0
        rss_decreasing =. 0.0
        if. mode-:'auto' do.
            increasing =. 'increasing'pava numbers
            decreasing =. 'decreasing'pava numbers
            rss_increasing =. values residual_square 0{::increasing
            rss_decreasing =. values residual_square 0{::decreasing
            direction =. 'increasing'
            fit =. increasing
            if. rss_decreasing<rss_increasing do.
                direction =. 'decreasing'
                fit =. decreasing
            end.
        else.
            fit =. mode pava numbers
        end.
        'fitted blocks' =. fit
        edf =. 0.0+#blocks
        extras =. (<direction),(<mode),(<blocks),(<rss_increasing),<rss_decreasing
    elseif. ((3{.method)-:'nw_')+.(3{.method)-:'ll_' do.
        extras =. kernel_fit (<positions),(<values),(<hundredths parameter),(<3}.method),(<(3{.method)-:'ll_'),<diagnostics
        fitted =. 5{::extras
        leverage =. 6{::extras
        has_edf =. 7{::extras
        edf =. 8{::extras
    elseif. 'loess'-:5{.method do.
        iterations =. 0
        if. robust do.
            iterations =. RobustIterations
        end.
        extras =. loess_fit (<positions),(<values),(<hundredths parameter),(<num 5}.method),(<iterations),<diagnostics
        fitted =. 5{::extras
        leverage =. 6{::extras
        edf =. 7{::extras
    else.
        extras =. spline_fit (<positions),(<values),(<num parameter),<diagnostics
        fitted =. 7{::extras
        leverage =. 10{::extras
        edf =. 11{::extras
    end.
    (<method),(<positions),(<numbers),(<values),(<fitted),(<leverage),(<has_edf),(<edf),<extras
)
model_evaluate =: 4 : 0
    'position need_weights' =. y
    name =. m_name x
    positions =. m_positions x
    count =. #positions
    extra =. m_extra x
    weights =. i.0
    if. name-:'linear' do.
        'xbar sxx slope intercept' =. extra
        estimate =. intercept+slope*position%100
        if. need_weights do.
            weights =. (1%count)+(((position%100)-xbar)*((positions%100)-xbar))%sxx
        end.
    elseif. ('running_mean'-:name)+.'running_median'-:name do.
        distance =. |positions-position
        nearest =. distance i.<./distance
        estimate =. nearest{m_fitted x
        if. need_weights do.
            'first last' =. nearest{extra
            selected =. first+i.1+last-first
            weights =. (1%#selected)selected}count$0.0
        end.
    elseif. name-:'isotonic' do.
        selected =. 0>.(_1++/positions<:position)
        estimate =. selected{m_fitted x
    elseif. ((3{.name)-:'nw_')+.(3{.name)-:'ll_' do.
        extra kernel_evaluate position return.
    elseif. 'loess'-:5{.name do.
        'estimate ignored weights' =. extra loess_local position
    else.
        estimate =. extra spline_estimate position
        if. need_weights do.
            weights =. extra spline_weights position
        end.
    end.
    (<1),(<estimate),<weights
)
validation =: 3 : 0
    'method parameter points direction folds' =. y
    predictions =. (#points)$0.0
    defined =. (#points)$0
    for_group. i.folds do.
        training =. ((group~:folds|i.#points)#i.#points){points
        model =. fit_model (<method),(<parameter),(<training),(<direction),(<0),<0
        for_index. group+folds*i.>.((#points)-group)%folds do.
            'valid estimate weights' =. model model_evaluate ((<index,0){points),0
            predictions =. estimate index}predictions
            defined =. valid index}defined
        end.
    end.
    ((1{"1 points)%100)cross_validation_score (<predictions),<defined
)

select_models =: 4 : 0
    points =. x
    mode =. y
    observed =. (1{"1 points)%100
    entries =. 0$a:
    for_box. Methods do.
        name =. >box
        candidates =. 0$a:
        scores =. i.0
        valid_scores =. i.0
        for_parameter_box. parameters name do.
            parameter =. >parameter_box
            candidate =. fit_model (<name),(<parameter),(<points),(<mode),(<0),<1
            if. name-:'spline' do.
                valid =. 1
                score =. observed generalized_score (<m_fitted candidate),<m_edf candidate
            else.
                'valid score' =. validation (<name),(<parameter),(<points),(<mode),<#points
            end.
            candidates =. candidates,<(<parameter),(<valid),(<score),(<m_has_edf candidate),(<m_edf candidate),<0
            scores =. scores,score
            valid_scores =. valid_scores,valid
        end.
        best =. _1
        parameter =. '-'
        if. name-:'isotonic' do.
            parameter =. mode
        end.
        if. #candidates do.
            best =. scores choose_candidate valid_scores
            candidate =. best{::candidates
            parameter =. 0{::candidate
            candidate =. (<1)5}candidate
            candidates =. (<candidate)best}candidates
        end.
        model =. fit_model (<name),(<parameter),(<points),(<mode),(<1),<1
        direction =. mode
        if. name-:'isotonic' do.
            direction =. 0{::m_extra model
            parameter =. direction
        end.
        if. (best>:0)*.-.name-:'spline' do.
            loo =. best{scores
        else.
            'valid loo' =. validation (<name),(<parameter),(<points),(<direction),<#points
        end.
        kfold =. validation (<name),(<parameter),(<points),(<direction),<Folds
        gcv =. 0.0
        if. name-:'spline' do.
            gcv =. best{scores
        end.
        entries =. entries,<(<name),(<parameter),(<model),(<loo),(<kfold),(<candidates),(<gcv),(<0$a:),<0$a:
    end.
    entries
)

diagnostics =: 4 : 0
    entry =. x
    linear_rss =. y
    model =. e_model entry
    observed =. m_values model
    residuals =. observed-m_fitted model
    count =. #observed
    rss =. ordered_sum *:residuals
    mean =. (ordered_sum observed)%count
    tss =. ordered_sum *:observed-mean
    has_edf =. m_has_edf model
    edf =. m_edf model
    df =. 0.0
    rse =. 0.0
    has_nonlinear =. 0
    nonlinear =. 0.0
    if. has_edf do.
        df =. count-edf
        rse =. %:rss%df
        has_nonlinear =. (-.'linear'-:e_name entry)*.edf>2
        if. has_nonlinear do.
            nonlinear =. ((linear_rss-rss)%(edf-2))%(rss%df)
        end.
    end.
    centered =. residuals-(ordered_sum residuals)%count
    denominator =. ordered_sum *:centered
    acf =. i.0
    for_lag. 1+i.5 do.
        sum =. 0.0
        for_index. i.count-lag do.
            sum =. sum+(index{centered)*(index+lag){centered
        end.
        acf =. acf,sum%denominator
    end.
    dw =. 0.0
    for_index. 1+i.count-1 do.
        difference =. (index{residuals)-(index-1){residuals
        dw =. dw+difference*difference
    end.
    largest =. (|residuals)i.>./|residuals
    signs =. *residuals#~residuals~:0
    positive =. +/signs>0
    negative =. +/signs<0
    runs =. 1++/(}.signs)~:}:signs
    nonzero =. positive+negative
    product =. 2*positive*negative
    runs_mean =. 1+product%nonzero
    variance =. (product*(product-nonzero))%((nonzero*nonzero)*(nonzero-1))
    defined_values =. i.0
    for_estimate_box. e_grid entry do.
        'valid estimate weights' =. >estimate_box
        if. valid do.
            defined_values =. defined_values,estimate
        end.
    end.
    differences =. (}.defined_values)-}:defined_values
    differences =. differences#~differences~:0
    turning =. +/(*(}.differences))~:*}:differences
    (<residuals),(<rss),(<has_edf),(<edf),(<df),(<rse),(<1-rss%tss),(<has_nonlinear),(<nonlinear),(<acf),(<dw%rss),(<runs),(<positive),(<negative),(<(runs-runs_mean)%%:variance),(<largest),(<quantiles residuals),<turning
)

analyze =: 4 : 0
    points =. x
    positions =. 0{"1 points
    count =. #points
    grid =. ({.positions)+<.((i.GridPoints)*({:positions)-{.positions)%(GridPoints-1)
    entries =. points select_models y
    linear_rss =. (m_values e_model 0{::entries)residual_square m_fitted e_model 0{::entries
    scores =. i.0
    for_index. i.#entries do.
        entry =. index{::entries
        estimates =. 0$a:
        for_position. grid do.
            estimates =. estimates,<(e_model entry)model_evaluate position,0
        end.
        entry =. (<estimates)7}entry
        entry =. (<entry diagnostics linear_rss)8}entry
        entries =. (<entry)index}entries
        scores =. scores,e_loo entry
    end.
    ranking =. /:scores
    agreements =. 0$a:
    best =. e_grid ({.ranking){::entries
    for_entry_box. entries do.
        own =. e_grid >entry_box
        used =. 0
        sum =. 0.0
        maximum =. _1.0
        at =. 0
        for_index. i.#grid do.
            a =. index{::own
            b =. index{::best
            if. (0{::a)*.0{::b do.
                delta =. |(1{::a)-1{::b
                used =. used+1
                sum =. sum+delta*delta
                if. delta>maximum do.
                    maximum =. delta
                    at =. index
                end.
            end.
        end.
